note: Shared data source for the marketing /providers page and the local cockpit providers view. BRAND.md rule: present maturity honestly per surface. Do not claim parity.

oauth_cli.label: OAuth CLI
oauth_cli.description: Reuse a provider's own CLI via OAuth device/login flow. The operator authenticates once through the vendor's real auth flow; Heiwa wraps the CLI as a provider surface. No API key required. Paid subscription credits apply where the vendor allows.

subscription.label: Subscription reuse
subscription.description: Route work through flat-rate consumer subscriptions the operator already pays for. Functions as a feature of the OAuth CLI lane where the vendor's CLI honors subscription quota.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Standard pay-per-token API access via vendor-issued key. Heiwa stores the key locally on the operator's machine; it never touches heiwa.ltd.

local.label: Local
local.description: Models running on the operator's own hardware. Zero cost, zero data egress, lowest latency for supported sizes.

stable.label: Stable
stable.description: Wired, exercised, used in daily routing.

beta.label: Beta
beta.description: Wired, works in the happy path, edges unproven.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.description: Present in the provider registry but not yet a default route.

providers.name: Claude Code
providers.description: Anthropic's first-party CLI. OAuth login reuses Claude Pro or Claude Max subscription credit.

providers.name: Codex
providers.description: OpenAI's first-party CLI. OAuth login reuses ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription credit.

providers.name: Gemini CLI
providers.description: Google's first-party Gemini CLI. OAuth login reuses Google AI Pro entitlements.

providers.name: Antigravity
providers.description: Google's standalone agentic CLI. Separate rate group from Gemini CLI — stacks with it under one Google AI Pro subscription.

providers.name: Ollama
providers.description: Local model runtime. Always preferred when the selected model is available on the operator's machine.

providers.name: Anthropic API
providers.description: Direct pay-per-token access. Alternative to the Claude Code OAuth CLI lane.

providers.name: OpenAI API
providers.description: Direct pay-per-token access. Alternative to the Codex OAuth CLI lane.

providers.name: Gemini API
providers.description: Direct pay-per-token access via Google AI Studio key.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: Remote multi-model gateway. Useful as an escape hatch when a specific model is needed and no first-party lane covers it.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.description: Copilot subscription reuse. Not yet wired; on the OAuth CLI lane roadmap.

providers.name: Qwen (cloud)
providers.description: Cloud Qwen via API key. Local Qwen variants already work via the Ollama lane.

providers.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
providers.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — self-hosted inference servers, LAN model hosts, niche providers.

local.description: Local models. Unlimited. Always preferred when capable.

google.description: Google AI Pro group. Shared across Gemini CLI and API.

google_bonus.description: Antigravity bonus group. Separate from main Google group.

anthropic.description: Anthropic group. Shared across Claude Code and Anthropic API.

openai.description: OpenAI group. Shared across Codex and OpenAI API.
